description: Canonical registry of all normative MLS-Exporter labels in Arkret v1. Each label is a wire-breaking security-domain-separation parameter: implementations MUST use the exact label string and Context field shape, MUST NOT derive with an empty Context, and MUST NOT migrate or reuse keys across distinct labels without a new profile. Domain separation is defined by exact label inequality; forbid_reuse_with is a non-exhaustive human/tooling hint and MUST NOT be interpreted as an allow-list or require symmetric closure. Per-entry defined_in points to the normative source. See zh/crypto-media/media-service-binding.md §8 and conformance/conformance-vectors.md §12.7.

labels.label: ak.rtc-frame-key/v1
labels.purpose: SFrame per-sender media frame key (E2EE media frames)

labels.label: ak.rtc-transcript-key/v1
labels.purpose: Encryption key for a call transcription artifact (transcribe pipeline, distinct from media frame and recording keys)

labels.label: arkret-reaction-routing-v1
labels.purpose: Keyed-HMAC key for the plaintext reaction routing tag in E2EE Realms (reaction_routing_hmac_v1 = HMAC-SHA256(key, utf8(canonical_emoji)); the exporter output is the HMAC key)

labels.label: arkret-mention-routing-v1
labels.purpose: Keyed-HMAC key for the opt-in mention routing sidecar tag in E2EE Realms (mention_routing_hmac_v1 = HMAC-SHA256(key, utf8(mentioned_did)); the exporter output is the HMAC key; Sync Service MUST NOT derive, receive or persist the exporter secret)

labels.label: arkret-aead-sender-nonce-prefix-v1
labels.purpose: Per-sender AEAD nonce prefix for every AEAD-bearing v1 envelope (nonce = sender_nonce_prefix || device_nonce_counter_be64); canonical derivation defined once in encoding.md, domain documents only declare their `purpose` value
labels.context_encoding: canonical-bytes of the JSON object {"key_ref", "epoch", "device_id", "purpose", "aead_profile"} (not a bare string)

labels.label: ak.history-v1
labels.purpose: Per-epoch history_secret root for mls-exporter-aead-v1 content encryption; may be retained and re-sealed to authorized later joiners via ak.realm_key.share
labels.context_encoding: realm_id UTF-8 bytes exactly as serialized in the enclosing Realm id string
labels.output_length: KDF.Nh for the active MLS ciphersuite
